cc:Work.dc:title: Tray - GridfinityBase
cc:Work.dc:description: A parameterized Gridfinity base This is a configurable gridfinity base. This design is based on Zach Freedman's Gridfinity system Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes GridfinityBase --x 3 --y 3 --panel_x 100 --panel_y 100 --h 10 --thickness 3 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes GridfinityBase --y --panel_x --panel_y --h --reference
